failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of acetonitrile exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 50°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Precipitation of reaction by-products at low flow rates
failure_modes.mitigation: Increase flow rate periodically to flush reactor

failure_modes.cause: Inadequate heat exchange leading to temperature drift
failure_modes.mitigation: Install additional temperature sensors and feedback control

validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.07363 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Conduct temperature stability test at 50°C for 2 hours; ensure temperature deviation < 1°C
Perform periodic high-flow flush test to assess reactor fouling potential
